title: Questions 153-154 refer to the following text-message chain.
passage_1:
Owen Marsh (2:02 P.M.)
Have you almost finished the final drawings for the Harborview clinic? I want to make sure we are still on schedule to send the plans to the council on June 17. If we need to postpone the submission, I’ll have to notify the marketing and finance teams.

Nadia Roy (2:03 P.M.)
Don’t worry. I’m just about to start the last blueprint. I’ll send you my revisions on Thursday afternoon.

Owen Marsh (2:04 P.M.)
Perfect. That will give me enough time to check everything. Have you had to make a lot of changes to the design?

Nadia Roy (2:06 P.M.)
It is taking longer than expected. But most of the corrections have been small and quick to make. I’ll be glad when this project is over, though.

Owen Marsh (2:07 P.M.)
That’s understandable. You should consider taking some time off then.
